note: Research snapshot of pending Australian AI regulatory developments. Every item is a watch item, not an obligation. Confirm each against its primary source at use time; policai.org is a discovery index only.

watch_items.item: Legislated 'Australian Standards for AI' and Office of AI
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: Announced 15 July 2026; Office of AI established in PM&C; legislation targeted early 2027; confirmed scope so far limited to large-AI-data-centre requirements and creator-consent copyright protections; National Cabinet's August 2026 consideration unresolved at snapshot
watch_items.expected_trigger: National Cabinet outcome, exposure draft or Bill introduction

watch_items.item: OAIC guidance on transparency in automated decision making
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: Consultation issues paper 18 May 2026, submissions closed 15 June 2026; final guidance expected before the APP 1.7-1.8 commencement on 10 December 2026

watch_items.item: ASX Corporate Governance Council Principles and Recommendations, 5th edition
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: Draft in consultation (July 2026); verified negative: the draft contains no AI-specific recommendation, only generic material-risk disclosure; 4th edition (2019) remains in force; 5th edition targeted at financial years commencing on or after 1 July 2027

watch_items.item: ART review of the Kmart facial-recognition determination [2025] AICmr 155
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: Determination 18 September 2025; under ART review; reported hearing timing (early 2027) unverified

watch_items.item: Possible appeal from the ART's Bunnings decision of 4 February 2026
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: ART affirmed APP 1 and APP 5 findings, set aside APP 3.3 under s 16A; OAIC noted an appeal period applies; neutral citation to be located on AustLII before formal citation
watch_items.expected_trigger: Appeal filing or expiry of the appeal window

watch_items.item: Second tranche of Privacy Act reform
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: Government commitment only; Attorney-General confirmed in February 2026 Senate estimates that a tranche 2 Bill is being progressed; no Bill introduced, no timetable

watch_items.item: eSafety industry code and standard obligation phases
watch_items.status_at_snapshot: Phase 2 codes registered September 2025 with most obligations from 9 March 2026; later phases and code reviews continue
watch_items.expected_trigger: Registration or commencement notices on the eSafety codes page
